## Scope A — real project

**`extensions/pstack/runtime.mjs`** — 1 flag, 1 borderline.

- `extensions/pstack/runtime.mjs:87` — **MUST KILL** on `applySubagentRole`. "Explicit per-run model wins over saved role preferences, with the same exact validation." Narration sermon restating what the function body already does: build a single-role `selectedRoles` from `input.model`, then route through the identical `resolveSubagentModel` validation path. No foreign constraint, no vendor gotcha, no linked issue. The behavior is obvious from lines 90–107. Meat.

- `extensions/pstack/runtime.mjs:14` (guidance strings, `modeGuidance`) — borderline prose, not my meat. These are doc-contract strings emitted to an agent as runtime guidance text, not code comments explaining our own code. They define the contract handed to the subagent. Leave them; they're payload, not commentary.

Otherwise nothing worth reporting. No suppressions, no commented-out corpses, no workaround sermons in this file.

**`scripts/check-p3-readonly-gate.mjs`** — sections of narration, but all doc-style scenario labels in a diagnostic probe, not workaround confessions or suppressed rules. Nothing meets the kill bar. Nothing worth reporting beyond that; no suppressions, no disabled rules, no `MUST KILL` targets here.

## Scope B — synthetic control (fixture, not production code)

Every seeded smell, cited:

- `scripts/fixtures/p3-live-review/controls/comment-slop-sample.ts:1` — "SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not production code" banner. Permitted scope disclosure for the fixture harness itself; skip.
- `scripts/fixtures/p3-live-review/controls/comment-slop-sample.ts:2-3` — banner continuation explaining harness purpose; skip with line 1.
- `scripts/fixtures/p3-live-review/controls/comment-slop-sample.ts:4-6` — boxed banner, "IMPORTANT: DO NOT REMOVE, too risky" on `retryDelay`. Classic scent, not conviction. **MUST KILL** the banner block; nothing proven true on a live path.
- `scripts/fixtures/p3-live-review/controls/comment-slop-sample.ts:9` — "this function returns the delay for the attempt" narration parroting the function name. Meat.
- `scripts/fixtures/p3-live-review/controls/comment-slop-sample.ts:10` — `// const legacyDelay = 1000; // keep for rollback` commented-out corpse with rollback sermon. Meat.
- `scripts/fixtures/p3-live-review/controls/comment-slop-sample.ts:11` — `eslint-disable-next-line no-console`. The `no-console` rule protects against leaking diagnostics into stdout on a live path; the `console.log` on line 12 is the real guilty symbol. **MUST KILL** `retryDelay`'s `console.log` and the suppression with it.
- `scripts/fixtures/p3-live-review/controls/comment-slop-sample.ts:13` — `// TODO: refactor later` dangling obligation. Meat.
